1.title: Your car stays home
1.description: Instead of going to the yard, the vehicle goes directly to your home with a monitoring device.

2.title: Real savings
2.description: No towing costs, no daily yard fees. You only pay your outstanding issues.

3.title: Resolve from your phone
3.description: Track issues, upload receipts, and schedule device removal — all online.

4.title: Safe and transparent
4.description: The entire process is digitally recorded with full audit trail and real-time timeline.

5.title: No bureaucracy
5.description: Access the portal with your case code and resolve everything without lines or travel.

6.title: Easy scheduling
6.description: When everything is settled, pick a date and time to have the device removed.

1.a: It's a program that replaces vehicle towing. Instead of having your car towed, a monitoring device is installed and you take the vehicle home until you resolve all issues.

2.q: Can I use the car during the process?
2.a: No. The vehicle must remain parked at your residence throughout the entire process. The system monitors and detects any movement.

3.a: There are no towing fees or daily yard charges. You only pay your vehicle's outstanding issues (fines, registration, etc.).

4.q: What if I remove the device?
4.a: Removal is automatically detected and generates a serious violation, which may result in the physical towing of the vehicle to the yard.

5.q: How do I access the portal?
5.a: Simply use the case code you received during the traffic stop and your registered phone number. You'll receive an SMS code for verification.

1.title: Acceptance of Terms
1.content:
By accessing and using the Virtual Yard portal, you fully agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any provision, please do not use the service.

These terms govern the use of the digital platform intended for monitoring the virtual vehicle removal process.

2.title: Service Description
2.content:
Virtual Yard is a digital platform that allows citizens to monitor the home custody process of their vehicle, resolve documentary and financial issues, and schedule the removal of the monitoring device.

The service is offered as an alternative to the physical removal of the vehicle to the impound lot, through the installation of a GPS device.

3.title: Registration and Access
3.content:
Access to the portal is done through the case code provided during the traffic stop and the registered phone number. The citizen is responsible for keeping their access credentials confidential.

The SMS verification code is personal and non-transferable.

4.title: User Obligations
4.content:
The user agrees to keep the vehicle parked at their residence throughout the entire regularization process. Moving the vehicle or attempting to remove the installed GPS device is not permitted.

The user must provide accurate information and keep their data updated on the platform.

5.title: Limitation of Liability
5.content:
Virtual Yard is not responsible for temporary service interruptions due to scheduled maintenance or third-party technical failures.

The platform acts as a monitoring tool and does not replace the legal and administrative procedures of the traffic authority.

6.title: Changes to Terms
6.content:
We reserve the right to modify these Terms of Use at any time. Changes will be communicated through the platform and will take effect on the date of publication.

Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

1.title: Data Collected
1.content:
We collect the following personal data: full name, CPF (tax ID), phone number, vehicle plate, residential address, and GPS device location data.

We also collect platform usage data, such as pages accessed, access times, and actions performed.

2.title: Purpose of Processing
2.content:
Data is used to enable the virtual home custody service, including vehicle monitoring, issue management, and scheduling device removal.

Location data is used exclusively to verify compliance with home custody conditions.

3.title: Data Sharing
3.content:
Personal data may be shared with the traffic authority responsible for the removal process, as provided by current legislation.

We do not share personal data with third parties for commercial or marketing purposes.

4.title: Storage and Security
4.content:
Data is stored on secure servers with encryption in transit and at rest. We adopt technical and administrative measures to protect your data against unauthorized access.

Data is retained for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, respecting legal deadlines.

5.title: Data Subject Rights
5.content:
You have the right to access, correct, delete, and port your personal data, as provided by the LGPD. To exercise your rights, contact us through the platform's support channel.

You may also request information about data sharing and revoke your consent at any time.

1.title: What are Cookies
1.content:
Cookies are small text files stored on your browser when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.

Virtual Yard uses cookies to ensure the proper functioning of the platform.

2.title: Essential Cookies
2.content:
We use essential cookies for the basic operation of the platform, including authentication, security, and language preferences.

These cookies are necessary and cannot be disabled without compromising the use of the service.

3.title: Performance Cookies
3.content:
We use performance cookies to collect anonymous information about how users interact with the platform, enabling continuous improvements.

These cookies do not collect information that individually identifies the user.

4.title: Cookie Management
4.content:
You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect the platform's functionality.

For more information on how to manage cookies, consult your browser's documentation.

1.title: Legal Basis
1.content:
The processing of personal data by Virtual Yard is based on the legal grounds provided by Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law 13,709/2018), including compliance with legal obligations, execution of public policies, and data subject consent.

The traffic authority acts as the data controller, and Virtual Yard as the data processor.

2.title: Processing Principles
2.content:
We follow the LGPD principles: purpose, adequacy, necessity, free access, data quality, transparency, security, prevention, non-discrimination, and accountability.

We collect only the data strictly necessary for providing the virtual home custody service.

3.title: Data Subject Rights
3.content:
Under the LGPD, you have the right to confirmation of data processing, data access, correction of incomplete or outdated data, anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data, data portability, and consent revocation.

To exercise any of these rights, use the support channel available on the platform.

4.title: Data Protection Officer (DPO)
4.content:
The Data Protection Officer is responsible for handling data subject requests and communicating with the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).

To contact the Data Protection Officer, use the platform's support channel.

5.title: Security Incidents
5.content:
In case of a security incident that may pose a risk or relevant damage to data subjects, we will notify the National Data Protection Authority and affected data subjects, as required by the LGPD.

We adopt technical and administrative measures to prevent and mitigate security incidents.
